text:
devrel-ana: Announcing: Community Plugin Guides v0.2.0 is out! :tada: Lightweight how-tos, migration notes for v0.1 -> v0.2, and three example plugins (logger, auth-proxy, metrics). Release: https://github.com/redwood/community-plugins/releases/tag/v0.2.0
devrel-ana: Highlights: clearer CONTRIBUTING flow, plugin lint rules, and a tiny compatibility shim so older plugins still load. Aimed at making plugin onboarding <30min.
ci-bot: CI: tag `v0.2.0` created for redwood/community-plugins 44d All checks passed and artifacts published
security-rene: Nice work. Quick ask: can we add a signed-release checklist or GH release notes snippet about verifying checksums for binary artifacts?
devrel-ana: @security-rene yes, added a short section to RELEASES.md and an example `sha256sum` check in the notes.
community-joel: I'll schedule a short demo in the community call next week and link the migration notes. Also will ping maintainers to adopt the plugin-lint GH action.
devrel-ana: Quick demo snippet in release notes:
```
# try an example plugin
git clone https://github.com/redwood/community-plugins.git
cd community-plugins/examples/logger
pnpm install
pnpm run start:example
```
devrel-ana: Office hours tomorrow 2pm PT in #devrel-qa for a live walk-through and to help anyone migrate existing plugins. Ping me if you want a short 1:1 migration slot. :rocket:
